verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a general API with test mode, and shareable checkout links from the dashboard, but nothing documents creating products, prices, or checkout/payment links through the API. The API references only cover handling checkout and subscription events and setting up webhooks, which are adjacent capabilities, not programmatic provisioning.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent provision a new product, price, and payment link via the API in a single session
